mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS equipment_id, e.asset_code, e.name AS equipment_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count, ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, w.created_at, w.completed_at)) / 1000000, 2) AS avg_processing_seconds FROM work_orders w INNER JOIN equipment e ON e.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND e.id = w.equipment_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.status = 'COMPLETED' AND w.created_at IS NOT NULL AND w.completed_at IS NOT NULL AND w.completed_at >= #{startTime} AND w.completed_at < #{endTime} AND w.completed_at >= w.created_at GROUP BY e.id, e.asset_code, e.name ORDER BY avg_processing_seconds DESC, e.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
